description.en: Galeri is a landing page for art marketplaces, galleries, and creator communities: showcase featured works and artists, browse by medium, explain how buying works, compare plans, and grow a weekly newsletter.
description.id: Galeri adalah landing page untuk marketplace seni, galeri, dan komunitas kreator: pamerkan karya dan seniman unggulan, telusuri per medium, jelaskan cara membeli, bandingkan paket, dan kembangkan newsletter mingguan.
